BRISBANE, Calif., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Vera Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: VERA), a commercial-stage biotechnology company, today announced that the Company’s management team will participate in a fireside chat at the Guggenheim 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference, which is taking place in Boston, MA from November 9-11, 2026. The management team will also participate in one-on-one investor meetings.


**Fireside Chat Details:**
Date: Tuesday, November 10, 2026
Time: 11:30 AM ET
Webcast:[https://event.summitcast.com/view/oVDtKqmPn2tPc7VV7WsLAC/VAEZkbjVkcydrQYaGzVnEF](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=fgClaM2wEB6TwAcmJH-X1Rl6FpzejorWRnkSHV-TQG4ZWhf2z9E28RBJpdatY5GOGj726zgsa6vA5y6ApoA6mJji380gyb13VqyXGzGlutzmQJ52WJo_P94m0yccrEWwx1cXuyPD9cq9LgTs9PKfrErKRRxguNvXoKC8EuskDv7dnDHxduvBtcITEKGiV383G-0i6YQ5mDfG7D6YDvlHTi4s1Jg3dUisv8VhRWEiXxE8fbazQY6ZqoIPhAHihbLu)


A replay of the event will be available for 90 days and can be accessed by visiting the News & Events section of the Company’s website at ir.veratx.com.


**About Vera Therapeutics**


Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNA™ (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit[www.veratx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=5bKnW1bzcsEuXxPCss_NRv7H7BIBsaLCQWIWR7qx633wNpjjODXFd_WQ2wpqbZ5je8KXzaIbhiSq7IbK2uk36jexV4XeYyGHlIU6Qb8C1kC4uXSkKcDmGNRR2DpmgNh9fkHIlMa149bseP7hJj06x-9FDET_mraGmUDL9Gb0PdHSlRT8zlun4-qssCbslyLes4V9ktfagJ1nH8xn5m_dP-AGtpUZoJ3TR08p5-SGxC8=) .
